title: Environment Impact Assessment
definition: A statutory process under the Environment (Protection) Act, 1986, designed to identify, predict, and evaluate the environmental, social, and health consequences of proposed developmental projects before decision-making.
importanceInUpsc: EIA is a perennial favorite in GS Paper III (Environment/Development) and GS Paper II (Governance/Policy). It tests the balance between 'Ease of Doing Business' and 'Sustainable Development'.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Environment Impact Assessment.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
